simple.summary: מְדָתָא (Mᵉdâthâʼ) means Medatha , the father of Haman First listed occurrence: Esth 3 1.

definitions.full: H4099. Medatha הַמְּדָתָא proper name, masculine father of Haman (Persian mâh , moon ( mâha, month , Spieg APK 236 ) + data, given? so (written hamaodata Öttli; ᵐ5 Ἁμαδαθου (always Genitive); in Greek perhaps Μαδάτης [ Μαδάτας , Μαδέτης ], compare Xen Cyr, see 3. 41 Diod xvii,67 Pott ZMG 1859, 424 ); — הָֽאֲגָגִי הַמְּדָתָא Est 3:1 , 10 ; 8:5 ; 9:24 ; without האגגי 9:10 .
